en_title: Sony Issues Yet Another PS5 Firmware Update as Jailbreak Whac-a-Mole Continues Ahead of GTA 6 Release
cn_title: GTA 6发售在即，破解「打地鼠」之战持续，Sony再次发布PS5固件更新
opus_summary: Sony于11月2日推出PS5固件更新26.07-14.22.00，补丁说明证实其与安全有关。自制软件社区正持续尝试破解新固件，有人担忧若《GTA 6》所需固件遭破解，游戏可能在PS5上被盗版，甚至出现在PC上。

paragraphs.en: Sony has released yet another PS5 firmware update as it battles to keep a lid on the homebrew community’s ongoing effort to jailbreak the console ahead of the release of GTA 6.
paragraphs.cn: Sony再次发布了PS5固件更新，力图在GTA 6发售前遏制自制软件社区持续破解这款主机的努力。

paragraphs.en: PS5 firmware update 26.07-14.22.00, which weighs in at 1.267 GB, released today, November 2, and we have confirmation via the patch notes that it’s security related:
paragraphs.cn: PS5固件更新26.07-14.22.00于今天，即11月2日发布，大小为1.267 GB。我们通过更新说明确认，此次更新与安全有关：

paragraphs.en: Today’s update follows just 11 days after the release of 14.20 , which came on October 21 and whose patch notes did not mention security, but was widely seen as a response to recent events.
paragraphs.cn: 今天的更新距离14.20发布仅过去了11天。14.20于10月21日推出，其更新说明没有提及安全问题，但该更新被广泛视为对近期事件的回应。

paragraphs.en: The PlayStation homebrew scene has made headlines in the last month for releasing PS5 jailbreaks for prior firmwares. For example, late September, a jailbreak that supported all PS5 consoles running firmware 7.00-13.60 sent shockwaves through the homebrew community because, at the time, it meant that all PS5s, including the PS5 Pro, that hadn't been updated within the previous week were compatible with the jailbreak. This was of huge significance for Sony and the security of the PS5, as people with a jailbroken PS5 can modify their console, potentially opening the door to video game piracy.
paragraphs.cn: 过去一个月，PlayStation自制软件圈因发布针对PS5旧版固件的破解工具而成为新闻焦点。例如，9月下旬，一个支持所有运行7.00至13.60版本固件的PS5主机的破解工具在自制软件社区引起巨大震动，因为这在当时意味着，所有在此前一周内未更新的PS5，包括PS5 Pro，都兼容该破解工具。这对Sony和PS5的安全具有重大意义，因为拥有已破解PS5的人可以修改主机，从而可能为电子游戏盗版打开大门。

paragraphs.en: However, it was found that some PS5 games subsequently required the more recent 14.00 firmware in order to download updates, sparking a renewed effort to release a new jailbreak for the updated system software.
paragraphs.cn: 然而，随后有人发现，部分PS5游戏需要较新的14.00固件才能下载更新，这促使人们重新努力，为更新后的系统软件推出新的破解工具。

paragraphs.en: So, there is a game of Whac-A-Mole at play where the homebrew scene is working to release a new jailbreak for the latest PS5 firmware, then do it all over again when Sony releases a new firmware update designed to beef up security.
paragraphs.cn: 因此，一场「打地鼠」式的较量正在上演：自制软件圈努力为最新的PS5固件推出新的破解工具，而当Sony发布旨在加强安全性的新固件更新时，他们又得从头再来。

paragraphs.en: This in turn has sparked concern that if a PS5 jailbreak is made available for the firmware that is required by GTA 6, which comes out in less than a month, then it may be possible for Rockstar’s game to be pirated on PS5 and maybe even made available on PC.
paragraphs.cn: 这又引发了担忧：如果针对GTA 6所需固件的PS5破解工具问世，那么Rockstar的这款游戏可能会在PS5上遭到盗版，甚至可能被放到PC上。GTA 6将在不到一个月后发售。

paragraphs.en: One prominent member of the PlayStation homebrew community recently showed evidence of a jailbreak for the 14.10 firmware, but follow up comments suggested that dumping game executables wasn’t possible.
paragraphs.cn: PlayStation自制软件社区的一位知名成员最近展示了针对14.10固件的破解证据，但后续评论表明，无法转储游戏可执行文件。

paragraphs.en: Some believe GTA 6 will require at least 14.20 to run — or, now, potentially 14.22. And Sony may release further security updates before November 19.
paragraphs.cn: 一些人认为，GTA 6至少需要14.20才能运行——或者，以现在的情况来看，可能需要14.22。而Sony可能会在11月19日之前发布更多安全更新。

paragraphs.en: The question for Sony is whether it can do enough to eventually win this game of Whac-A-Mole with the homebrew scene. This is something of an existential crisis for Sony, which publishers and developers rely upon for the security of their PlayStation releases. But with the emergence of powerful AI models, the stakes have risen significantly.
paragraphs.cn: Sony面临的问题是，它能否采取足够的措施，最终赢得与自制软件圈的这场「打地鼠」之战。这对Sony来说可以说是一场生存危机，发行商和开发商都依赖它来保障其PlayStation发行作品的安全。但随着强大的AI模型出现，这场较量的利害关系已显著加重。

paragraphs.en: IGN reported on a hacker who had sparked an uproar within the PS5 homebrew scene for privately reporting an exploit to Sony and cashing in on a $50,000 reward, rather than keeping it confidential for the community.
paragraphs.cn: IGN曾报道，一名黑客因私下向Sony报告一个漏洞利用方式并拿到50,000美元赏金，而不是为社区对此保密，在PS5自制软件圈引发了轩然大波。
